product.title: Best of Boulder E-Bike Tour

description.text: Visit the places that make Boulder the “Happiest City in America” on a guided e-bike tour. The electric motor allows you to cover a huge range of attractions in the great outdoors, without getting winded. Stops include Pedego Boulder- Electric Bike Tours & Rentals, Settler's Park, Flatirons, Colorado Chautauqua: Park, University of Colorado at Boulder, National Center for Atmospheric Research - NCAR. Get comfortable with your e-bike during a short training session before the tour begins. Ideal for visitors basing in Boulder who want a guided Front Range experience without coordinating meeting points, trailheads, or photo locations on their own.
